desc:
🧙 Slow-paced MMORPG. Progress is earned, not rushed. Not an easy game, and that's on purpose.

📖 You never met your father, and your mother raised you alone. Then a portal opened in Dewdrop Village and a beast came through. When the fighting stopped, the farm was in ruins and your mother was gone. All she left was a letter that explains nothing and asks you to show it to no one.

📱 Minimum device (below this = lag)
Mobile: 8GB RAM, Snapdragon/Adreno
PC: quad-core, 8GB RAM, GTX 1050 / Iris Xe

🛠️ Made by medidecil & hsywerke. Two people, no studio, no budget.

⚠️ DISCLAIMER (Last audit Oct 13,2026)
This game contains AI assets. We are aiming for 0% AI assets.
3D: 203 of 2208 are AI (9.19%) | 2D: 39 of 217 are AI (17.97%)
